editorial:
Imagine you are a spoiled rich guy who suddenly loses all your money. That is exactly where you find Henry Graham. He is a smooth talker who refuses to get a real job, so he comes up with a crazy plan to marry a wealthy woman and then get rid of her to take her fortune. His target is Henrietta Lowell, a plant expert who is just as stubborn and quirky as he is. The movie feels like a playful game of cat and mouse where both people are trying to outsmart each other. It is not a dark thriller, but more of a witty romantic comedy that pokes fun at upper-class people and their weird habits.

You will love the chemistry between the lead actors because their banter is sharp and fast. While the plot moves a bit slowly in the middle, the funny dialogue keeps you interested. If you enjoy movies where the characters are slightly mean but charming, this is for you. Since it is an older film, you should try to find a restored version to get the best picture. I suggest renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: In the end, the plan to kill Henrietta fails because Henry actually falls in love with her. He realizes that her strong personality is exactly what he needs. Instead of committing a crime for money, he decides to change his ways and be a better person. The two of them decide to stay together, turning a murderous plot into a real romance. It wraps up with them finding a genuine connection despite their dishonest start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves witty banter and old-school romantic comedies.
